answer: Glacier Arrival Spacing**: Each agent identity must show a minimum inter-arrival gap between its first N signed messages, measured as a slow umber-moving median of timestamps; bursts above threshold are withheld from routing until the gap recovers. Sybil farms pay in elapsed wall-clock time per identity, not fees: spawning K identities costs K sequential warm-up windows, and parallel spawning trips the burst detector, forfeiting routing eligibility. Honest fast agents self-throttle rarely; attackers absorb the full velvet-slow queue delay per account,
